title: Sulphur 2 and LTX2.3-10Eros Video Generation Models
summary: High-fidelity open-source video generation models fine-tuned from the LTX-2.3 architecture. They specialize in cinematic realism, refined human kinesics, and consistent 3D camera motion for local, unrestricted workflows.
research_notes: Community-developed GGUF quantizations enable these 9B parameter models to run on consumer hardware with 8GB-12GB VRAM via ComfyUI.

evolution.summary: Derived from Lightricks' LTX-2.3; Sulphur 2 focused on eliminating robotic movement, followed by 10Eros which implemented layer-scaled merging to optimize Image-to-Video (I2V) performance and prompt following.
